lib/paint/three-layers: A three.js source is rendered through the paint camera: its perspective camera, pose and planes, in the world the planes share.
lib/paint/style: StampPainting shows a painting's planes as its camera looks at each frame.
lib/paint/shot: A shot's camera, clocks, motion nodes and plays are the animation feature's, over occurrences.
lib/paint/document: A sheet program is posed before its solve by each group's map, a similarity (painting-pose.ts).
lib/paint/gate: The gate poses its paper heron by a similarity, and checks where the pose puts its paint by the same map.
